content.comment_body: Hello, I'm currently working on the electrical drawings and software for the project, but I haven't received the actual hardware yet. I need to connect two analog input sensors (0-10V). Based on the documentation, it appears that the [product_name] base module can be configured to manage two analog inputs by connecting them to I7 and I8. To summarize: BASE MODULE: • I1: configured as I1 (digital input) • I2: configured as I2 (digital input) • I3: configured as I3 (digital input) • I4: configured as I4 (digital input) • I5: configured as I5 (digital input) • I6: configured as I6 (digital input) • I7: configured as AI1 (analog input) • I8: configured as AI2 (analog input) EXPANSION MODULE: • I1: is this mapped to I7 or I9? • I2: is this mapped to I8 or I10? • I3: is this mapped to I9 or I11? • I4: is this mapped to I10 or I12? Can anyone confirm if the analog inputs on the base module exclusively support 0-10V, and if that's possible without any additional external resistor circuits? Thank you
Hi, The first input on the expansion module is labeled as I9. You can review further details on page 24 of [url]. And yes, the analog inputs only support 0-10V.

The assignment of digital inputs and outputs stays consistent. Addresses I1 through I8 are always designated for the base module, even when analog inputs are used on the base module. For example: The first digital expansion module DM8 uses I9 to I12 and Q5 to Q8. The first digital expansion DM16 uses I9 to I16 and Q5 to Q12. Just a note: All relevant information can be found on page 24.
